description: Establish the working baseline and plumb the recovered per-cell PRESENTATION and per-row GEOMETRY through the data schemas and the data extractor, so the information the templated path currently throws away survives the model.Document -> schema hand-off and the JSON round-trip. This is the enabling step: it adds the data carriers but does not yet change rendering. Depends on nothing; blocks FEAT-002.
steps: Activate the environment: `. .venv/bin/activate` (recreate with `~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -e '.[dev]'` if .venv is missing). Run `sars unpack` to populate data/sars from sars.zip.

Capture and record the BASELINE numbers in this feature's findings: run `python tools/template_audit.py` (expect `no value lost 5/19; pagination matches 8/19; mean document similarity 97.27%`), `sars all` (expect `19/19 documents pass; mean text similarity 100.00%`), and `pytest -q`.

In src/sars/schema.py, add a lossless, JSON-round-trippable way to carry the recovered presentation of a cell. Introduce a small `CellStyle` dataclass (fields mirroring the meaningful subset of model.Style: family, size_pt, bold, italic, color, background, align, rotation) with sensible defaults so existing JSON without style still deserialises. Add an optional style carrier to the row/cell data structures that the templates consume. The design constraint from the user is explicit: DO NOT invent one shared structure across report families for elegance; add the carrier in a way each family can populate from its OWN recovered cells. A pragmatic approach that fits the existing header-driven schemas: store per-column (and per-total-cell) recovered CellStyle keyed the same way values are keyed today (e.g. alongside SchoolRankRow fields, in PerformanceRow/TabularRow value dicts under a parallel style map, and in the totals rows), so every emitted <td>/<th> can look up the exact style recovered for that cell. Ensure `sars.schema._coerce`/`_build`/`SCHEMA_BY_TYPE` reconstruct the new CellStyle nesting on `from_dict`/`from_json` (extend the `nested` map and list handling as needed). Verify round-trip with a quick `to_json`/`from_json` check on one extracted report.

Also carry per-row GEOMETRY: add a way for a data row (and the header band and total rows) to record the recovered row pitch (the true row height in points, from model.Table.row_heights()) so the template can set line-height to match the reference row pitch instead of a hardcoded value. Keep it optional/defaulted so fresh data with no geometry still renders.

In src/sars/extract_data.py, populate the new style + geometry carriers from the recovered model.Cell.style and the table's row_edges/row_heights as each row/section/total is walked. The extractor already has the classified model.Table with per-cell model.Style and geometry in scope in _extract_schools_rank, _extract_subjects_rank, _extract_best_students, _extract_school_slip and _extract_generic (via _group_data_rows / _rows_map / _full_capture). Add a small helper (e.g. `_cell_style(cell) -> CellStyle`) and use it wherever a value is currently captured, so the style travels with the value. For grouped/summary tables captured by column index (_full_capture) key the style by the same string index used for the value. Preserve existing behaviour when a cell is missing (default CellStyle).

Keep the competency handling intact: competency cells still resolve their deterministic colour via sars.competency as a FALLBACK, but a recovered background fill from the source cell now takes precedence (mirroring the conversion path's rule that the recovered colour always wins). Ensure _cell_style captures the recovered competency-cell background so the template prefers it.

Regenerate output/data by running `sars data`, and confirm the new fields appear in output/data/*.json and that `python -c` round-trip (schema.from_json(schema.to_json(...))) is lossless for at least MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK.

Run `ruff check` and `black --check` on all changed files and fix any findings. Do NOT change rendering yet (templates unchanged in this feature); template_audit and compare output may look identical until FEAT-002.
acceptance_criteria: src/sars/schema.py defines a CellStyle (or equivalent) carrier that survives to_json/from_json round-trip losslessly, and the schema dataclasses can carry per-cell recovered style plus per-row recovered pitch, all optional with defaults so pre-existing JSON still loads.

src/sars/extract_data.py populates the style + geometry carriers from the recovered model.Cell.style and model.Table geometry for the schools_rank/top_schools family at minimum, and for the other families it touches, without dropping any existing captured value.
`sars data` regenerates output/data/*.json including the new style/geometry fields; `schema.from_json(schema.to_json(extracted))` round-trips MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK with no loss.
`python tools/template_audit.py` reports token completeness no worse than baseline (>= no value lost 5/19; mean document similarity >= 97.27%).
`sars all` still reports `19/19 documents pass; mean text similarity 100.00%` (conversion path unaffected).
`pytest -q` passes; `ruff check` and `black --check` clean on changed files.
verification: . .venv/bin/activate && sars data && python -c "import json,glob; from sars import schema; d=json.load(open('output/data/MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK.json')); obj=schema.from_dict(d); assert schema.to_dict(obj)==d, 'round-trip mismatch'; print('round-trip OK')"
findings:
BASELINE (before changes): `python tools/template_audit.py` -> `no value lost 5/19; pagination matches 8/19; mean document similarity 97.27%`; `sars all` -> `19/19 documents pass; mean text similarity 100.00%`; `pytest -q` -> `37 passed` (run ~75-77s; note the full suite exceeds a 120s tool timeout intermittently, but completes; sars all also runs long, use a longer timeout).

IMPLEMENTATION: Added `CellStyle` dataclass to src/sars/schema.py mirroring the meaningful subset of model.Style (family, size_pt, bold, italic, color, background, align, rotation) with defaults so pre-style JSON still deserialises. Added optional carriers (all defaulted): per-row `styles: dict[str, CellStyle]` + `pitch: float` on StudentRow, DivisionSummaryRow, PerformanceRow, SchoolRankRow, SubjectRankRow, TabularRow; and total-row carriers `total_styles: dict[str, list[CellStyle]]` + `total_pitch: dict[str, float]` on SchoolsRankReport, SubjectsRankReport, TabularSection, GenericTabularReport. Extended schema._coerce to reconstruct `dict[str, CellStyle]` and `dict[str, list[CellStyle]]` nesting (checked more-nested pattern first) and added CellStyle to the `nested` map.

In src/sars/extract_data.py added helpers `_cell_style(cell)`, `_row_styles(row,n_cols)`, `_row_pitch(table,row_index)`, `_group_cols`, `_group_data_rows_ctx` (yields table+row-index), `_total_rows_full` (yields label,values,styles,pitch) and `_group_total_styles` (mirrors _group_totals label keying/ordinal disambiguation). Populated style+pitch in all touched families: schools_rank/top_schools (keyed by physical column index), subjects_rank (column index), best_students StudentRow (keyed by StudentRow field name), school slip candidate rows + division summary + performance/_full_capture tables. Pitch comes from model.Table.row_heights() (rounded 3dp).

COMPETENCY: recovered cell background fill is now captured verbatim in CellStyle.background, so it takes precedence over competency.background_for (which remains the fallback). Verified: MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK competency column (physical col 36) carries recovered fills #00b050 (Grade A), #92d050 (Grade B).

TEST CHANGE: tests/test_sars.py `test_competency_colour_is_not_stored_as_data` asserted the OLD design (no hex colour in JSON), which directly contradicts this feature's mandate to carry the recovered background. Renamed to `test_competency_colour_is_not_fabricated_into_data_fields`: now asserts recovered competency fills ARE carried in the style carrier and that no hex colour is fabricated into plain data (text) fields. NOTE for FEAT-002/003: templates must consume these carriers and emit them; conversion path must stay untouched.

VERIFICATION (after changes): `sars data` regenerated output/data/*.json with the new style/pitch fields; ALL 19 documents round-trip losslessly via schema.from_dict(to_dict(...)) (MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK confirmed byte-equal). `python tools/template_audit.py` -> `no value lost 5/19; pagination matches 8/19; mean document similarity 97.27%` (== baseline, expected - no rendering change yet). `sars all` -> `19/19 documents pass; mean text similarity 100.00%` (conversion path unaffected). `pytest -q` -> `37 passed`. `ruff check` clean; `black --check` clean (reformatted the new test set-comprehension). output/data/*.json regenerated and are part of this change; template_html/template_pdf/compare artefacts intentionally NOT regenerated here (rendering unchanged; those belong to FEAT-002/003).
